notes:
Here are three real options for preschool swim in Oakville this fall. I couldn't read a fall day, time or price for any of them, so I left those fields out.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Learn to Swim Parent and Tot / Preschool, Town of Oakville",
      "age_fit": "Preschool levels, up to Preschool E. A child must be the age required for the level by the program start date.",
      "source_name": "Town of Oakville"
    },
    {
      "name": "YMCA Preschool Swim Lessons, Peter Gilgan Family YMCA, 410 Rebecca Street",
      "age_fit": "3-5 years",
      "source_name": "YMCA of Oakville"
    },
    {
      "name": "Little Waves, Making Waves Swim School Oakville",
      "age_fit": "2-5 yr., class ratio 3:1",
      "source_name": "Making Waves Swim School"
    }
  ]
}
```

- **Town of Oakville:**
  - The class days, times and prices are on the town's registration booking pages, which sit behind a login, so I didn't read them.
  - The town's page says 
lessons follow the Lifesaving Society Swim for Life program
.
  - Fall registration opened 
Tuesday, August 11 at 7 a.m.
, and the town's site now says 
online registration for Fall programs is open
.
  - 
Winter registration opens Tuesday, December 1 at 7 a.m.

  - Non-residents register later: 
14 days after Oakville resident registration begins
.
- **YMCA of Oakville:**
  - Their page says 
swim lessons run in 12-week sessions with a one-week break between sessions
.
  - The preschool page I read doesn't give a day, time or price. The 410 Rebecca Street address comes from their Parent and Tot page, not the preschool page.
- **Making Waves:**
  - Its Oakville page lists Little Waves for 2-5 year olds. The page I read is dated before this fall.
  - Its calendar shows 
open registration for Fall 2026 on June 1st
.
  - The only price I saw was for spring (
$32.80 per lesson
), so I didn't include a price.

Goldfish Swim School Oakville (ages 4 months to 12 years, at 1130 Eighth Line) also came up. I left it out to keep to three picks.
